```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(gt)

top5_murders <- crime %>%
  arrange(desc(gun.murders)) %>%
  slice(1:10) %>%
  mutate(Rank = row_number()) %>%
  select(
    Rank,
    State = state,
    Rate = gun.murders
  )

top5_murders %>%
  gt() %>%
  fmt_number(columns = Rate, decimals = 2) %>%
  cols_label(
    Rate = "Gun Murder Rate (per 100k)"
  ) %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Top 5 States: Gun Murder Rate**")
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = Rank
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = State
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "right",
    columns = Rate
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 14,
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold"
  )
```

```{r}
# get states
states_sf <- usmap::us_map(regions = "states")
sf::st_geometry(states_sf) <- "geom"

# join data
map_data <- states_sf %>%
  left_join(crime, by = c("full" = "state"))

ggplot(map_data) +
  
  # base layer: same color, varying opacity
  geom_sf(
    aes(alpha = gun.deaths.100k),
    fill = "red",
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  
  # outline low regulation states
  geom_sf(
    data = subset(map_data, gunlaws.3cat == "low"),
    fill = NA,
    color = "red",
    linewidth = 1.4
  ) +
  
  scale_alpha(
    range = c(0.30, 0.99),
    name = "Deaths per 100k"
  ) +
  
  theme_void() +
  
  labs(
    title = "Gun Deaths per 100k by State",
    subtitle = "Higher opacity indicates higher death rates\nStates with weaker gun laws are outlined"
  )
```

```{r}
library(sf)

states_sf <- usmap::us_map(regions = "states")  # has: fips, abbr, full, geom

# centroids (one point per state)
centroids <- states_sf %>%
  mutate(.pt = st_centroid(geom),
         lon = st_coordinates(.pt)[,1],
         lat = st_coordinates(.pt)[,2]) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(full, lon, lat)

# join to your data (full state names)
crime2 <- crime %>%
  left_join(centroids, by = c("state" = "full"))

# proportional-symbol map (more interesting than choropleth)
ggplot(states_sf) +
  geom_sf(fill = "gray92", color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_point(
    data = crime2,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat, size = gun.deaths.100k, color = gunlaws.3cat),
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = crime2,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat),
    color = "white",
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#641220", "#a11d33", "#e01e37")) +
  scale_size(range = c(2.5, 10)) +
  theme_void()
```

```{r}
library(usmap)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)
library(png)
library(scales)

# --- 1) Get state geometry + centroids (full state names) ---
states_sf <- usmap::us_map(regions = "states")

centroids <- states_sf %>%
  mutate(.pt = st_centroid(geom),
         lon = st_coordinates(.pt)[,1],
         lat = st_coordinates(.pt)[,2]) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(full, lon, lat)

crime2 <- crime %>%
  left_join(centroids, by = c("state" = "full"))

# --- 2) Download + read the splat image once ---
img_url  <- "https://freesvg.org/img/1526478173.png"
img_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
download.file(img_url, img_file, mode = "wb")
splat_png <- readPNG(img_file)

# --- 3) Build one annotation layer per state (size scaled by deaths) ---
# Size is in "map degrees" — tune these two numbers.
crime2 <- crime2 %>%
  mutate(s = rescale(gun.deaths.100k, to = c(0.6, 2.0)))  # <- adjust range for bigger/smaller splats

splat_layers <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(crime2)), function(i) {
  row <- crime2[i, ]
  if (any(!is.finite(c(row$lon, row$lat, row$s)))) return(NULL)

  rg <- rasterGrob(splat_png, interpolate = TRUE)

  annotation_custom(
    rg,
    xmin = row$lon - row$s, xmax = row$lon + row$s,
    ymin = row$lat - row$s, ymax = row$lat + row$s
  )
})

# --- 4) Plot (light theme) ---
p <- ggplot(states_sf) +
  geom_sf(fill = "gray97", color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
  splat_layers +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Gun Deaths per 100k — Splat Map",
    subtitle = "Splat size scales with gun deaths per 100k (one splat per state)"
  ) +
  theme_void()

p
```

```{r}
library(personograph)

avg_crime_murders = mean(crime$crime.rate.murder)
avg_gun_murders = mean(crime$gun.murders)
gun_to_crime_murders <- avg_gun_murders / avg_crime_murders


murder_prop <- list(
  "Other Crime Murders" = 1 - gun_to_crime_murders,
  "Gun Murders" = gun_to_crime_murders
)

personograph(murder_prop, n.icons = 100, icon.style = 6, color = list("Gun Murders" = "red", "Other Crime Murders" = "gray"))
```

```{r}
state_murders <- crime |> 
  group_by(state) |> 
  summarize(
    murder_prop = gun.murders / crime.rate.murder
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    gun_murder_prop = murder_prop,
    other_murder_prop = 1 - murder_prop
  )

par(mfrow = c(5, 10), mar = c(1, 0.5, 1.5, 0.5))

for (i in 1:nrow(state_murders)) {
  
  props <- list(
    "Other" = state_murders$other_murder_prop[i],
    "Gun" = state_murders$gun_murder_prop[i]
  )
  
  personograph(props, n.icons = 100, icon.style = 6, color = list("Gun" = "red", "Other" = "gray"), plot.width = 0.95, fig.title = state_murders$state[i])
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

```{r}
library(grid)

state_gun_deaths <- crime |> 
  group_by(state) |> 
  summarize(
    murder_prop = gun.murders / gun.deaths.100k
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    murder_prop = murder_prop,
    other_prop = 1 - murder_prop
  )

for (i in 1:nrow(state_gun_deaths)) {
  
  props <- list(
    "Other" = state_gun_deaths$other_prop[i],
    "Murder" = state_gun_deaths$murder_prop[i]
  )
  
  png(
    filename = paste0("personograph/", state_gun_deaths$state[i], ".png"),
    width = 1000,
    height = 1000,
    res = 300
  )
  
  personograph(props, n.icons = 100, icon.style = 6, color = list("Murder" = "red", "Other" = "gray"), plot.width = 0.95, fig.title = state_gun_deaths$state[i])
  
  dev.off()
}

```
